_notes.wild_held_item_rule: src/pokemon.c SetWildMonHeldItem: roll 0-99; <45 none, <95 itemCommon (50%), else itemRare (5%); if both slots are the same non-NONE item it is held 100%. A lead with Compound Eyes uses 20/60/20 instead (none/common/rare). Not applied for legendary/trainer/pyramid/pike battles. Altering Cave has its own table.
_notes.placeholder: SPECIES_OLD_UNOWN_B..Z (252-276) are unused filler entries, flagged placeholder=true; the 28 Unown forms above NUM_SPECIES are forms of SPECIES_UNOWN and have no own species_info entry.
_notes.female_pct: null = genderless; derived from the decomp's PERCENT_FEMALE() byte macro (gender_ratio_byte).
